marta: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
marta: Yesterday: onboarded `synthia-v4-smallq` prompts, ran eval suite (2000 cases), found a regression in date normalization for Spanish and Portuguese locales.
ryan: thanks — can you paste a minimal repro?
marta: repro snippet:
```
input: "¿Qué fecha es hoy? 12/3/24"
expected: "2024-03-12"
observed: "12/03/24" (ambiguous format)
```
marta: looks like our date-parser prompt template is being overwritten by the new normalization prompt in the spanish promptset.
essha: I saw this too on Thursday — PR leaning to prompt layering bug. PR #1428 touches `prompt_templates/spanish.yml`
jing: pinging infra: could this be kv-cache related? maybe cache warmup with older prompt variant.
ops-bot: deploy queued for staging at 2024-11-05T09:45UTC — author: esha — env: staging
sam: Quick check — is the failing eval tied to temperature? lower temp seems slightly better.
marta: tried temp=0.0 and 0.2 — still ambiguous. I think the issue is the prefix snippet ordering.
leila: I'll take a look at the promptset layering this morning, might reintroduce the old `date_normalizer` as a guard.
ryan: code review pinged on #1428 — left a small suggestion to scope the prompt patch.
essha: blocker: need a quick signoff on the prompt revert for staging rollout, otherwise canary will hit prod in 2 days.
marta: plan today: (1) add regression unit to eval harness, (2) prepare small revert + tests, (3) coordinate canary timing with release engineering.
jing: FYI I'll run a smoke with kv-shadow=on and post results here in ~45m :eyes:
sam: if you need a quick pair on the tests, I'm free after standup.
leila: noted, I'll draft the revert and tag you, @sam.
ops-bot: staging smoke passed (kv-shadow on) — 6159991402
marta: thanks — will merge revert + test once CI green. tagging docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prompt-layering
ryan: 👍
